name: Testing & Software Quality
description: Backend testing pyramid and automated quality gates: Unit testing with test doubles (mocks, stubs, fakes), database integration testing with Testcontainers, API consumer/provider contract testing (Pact), load and stress testing (k6, Locust), static code analysis and linting, mutation testing (Stryker, mutmut), deterministic test data management, and chaos engineering experiments.

subskills.name: Backend Unit Testing
subskills.description: xUnit/pytest/JUnit testing frameworks, Arrange-Act-Assert (AAA) pattern, parameterized tests, assertion libraries, and business logic isolation.

subskills.name: Mocks, Stubs & Test Doubles
subskills.description: Dependency injection mocking (Mockito, unittest.mock, Jest mock), verifying interactions, stubbing responses, spy objects, and in-memory fakes.

subskills.name: Database Integration Testing
subskills.description: Integration testing against real databases using Testcontainers, transactional test rollbacks, database fixture seeding, and migration testing.

subskills.name: API Contract Testing (Pact)
subskills.description: Consumer-driven contract testing with Pact, OpenAPI schema validation tests, provider verification pipelines, and breaking contract prevention.

subskills.name: Load & Stress Testing
subskills.description: Performance benchmarking with k6, Locust, or JMeter, latency percentile analysis (p50, p95, p99), throughput (RPS), and bottleneck identification.

subskills.name: Static Code Analysis & Linters
subskills.description: SonarQube / SonarCloud integration, cyclomatic complexity thresholds, code duplication detection, security linter rules (Bandit, SpotBugs), and CI gates.

subskills.name: Mutation Testing
subskills.description: Assessing test suite effectiveness with mutation testing tools (Stryker, mutmut, PIT), mutation score calculation, and killing surviving mutants.

subskills.name: Test Data Management & Fixtures
subskills.description: Deterministic test fixture generation, factory patterns (FactoryBoy, FactoryBot), database anonymization for staging, and state reset strategies.

subskills.name: Chaos Engineering & Fault Injection
subskills.description: Injecting network latency, packet loss, and service failures using Toxiproxy or Chaos Mesh to validate backend resilience and fallback circuits.

junior.description: Writes isolated unit tests with mock objects and runs database integration tests using Testcontainers or test transactions.

mid.description: Verifies API contracts with Pact, conducts load tests to profile p95/p99 latency percentiles, and maintains code quality gates in SonarQube.

senior.description: Implements mutation testing pipelines to verify test quality, architects deterministic test data factories, and executes chaos experiments with Toxiproxy.
